terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "cloudhealth_account_id" {
  description = "AWS account ID of the CloudHealth SaaS platform account permitted to assume the cross-account role."
  type        = string
  default     = "123456789012"
}

variable "external_id" {
  description = "External ID that must be supplied when the CloudHealth platform assumes the role."
  type        = string
  default     = "cloudhealth-external-id"
}

variable "role_name" {
  description = "Name of the cross-account IAM role for CloudHealth."
  type        = string
  default     = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
}

variable "policy_name" {
  description = "Name of the customer-managed read-only IAM policy for CloudHealth."
  type        = string
  default     = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CloudHealthAssumeRole"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external_id]
    }
  }
}

  statement {
    sid    = "ReadOnlyCostAndUsageAnalysis"

      "organizations:List*",

resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth_iam_role" {
  name               = var.role_name
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_assume_role.json

  tags = {
    Name      = var.role_name
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Purpose   = "CloudHealth cost and usage analysis"
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth_iam_policy" {
  name        = var.policy_name
  description = "Customer-managed read-only policy for CloudHealth cost and usage analysis."

  tags = {
    Name      = var.policy_name
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Purpose   = "CloudHealth cost and usage analysis"
  }
}

  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_iam_role.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_iam_policy.arn
}
